messages:
Alex: Quick follow-up thread for the observability postmortem (missing spans -> bad aggregation -> ETL lag). I’ll list owners + ETAs. Ack here please.

Maria: Ack. I’ll own ETL lag RCA and short-term mitigation (rate limiting + backpressure). ETA 2026-04-05.

Sam: I’ll take aggregation correctness (boundary/window fixes) and add unit + integration tests. ETA 2026-03-29.

Jen: I’ll build a missing-span detector metric, update the runbook, and add paging for sustained gaps.

Olivia: I’ll draft a staged backfill and verification plan. Need Sam’s agg fix before prod backfill. Staging dry-run target: 2026-03-31.

IncidentBot: Recurrence note: span-loss at batch boundary seen multiple times in past 180 days. Flagging `recurring-observability-gap`.

Sam: Problem example: `SELECT time_bucket('1m', ts), service, count(*) FROM spans GROUP BY 1,2;` Consumers crossing bucket boundary cause miscounts without aligned partitioning.

Maria: RCA (brief): consumer commit race at partition rotation drops in-flight spans. Repro: `./tools/repro_consumer --case=rotate-commit`. Proposed fix: idempotent checkpointing + commit buffering.

Jen: Monitoring: add `spans.missing_rate` gauge, alert if >0.25% over 10m. Runbook: steps to reconcile, when to page oncall, and how to trigger backfill.

Olivia: Staged backfill sketch: compute per-agg deltas into temp table, validate checksums, then apply with upsert and dedupe. Will run in staging first.

Alex: Created Jira: RD-9350 (ETL RCA), RD-9351 (aggregation fixes + tests), RD-9352 (span detector + runbook), RD-9353 (staged backfill). Weekly sync Tue 10:00 PT starting 2026-03-24.

LegalOps: Reviewing reprocessing for PII risk. If raw spans contain PII we may require redaction before backfill. ETA 48h.

Alex: Thanks all. Keep updates in RD-9350..9353 and post short status notes in #incidents before the weekly. If blockers, DM me or @oncall.
